changelog.summary: Scopes setup to small engineering teams and defaults to one workflow unless access or lifecycle boundaries require a split.
Makes the Report dashboard the primary asynchronous review surface, with Ask in chat for discussion and separate durable approval and application.
Separates repair preparation from application: verified candidates become durable pending reviews, and a later action route validates approval and current source state before applying.
Adds an explicit inspect-first discovery step, focused customer questions, recorded user direction, and a clear boundary that installation is not approval.

title: Browser Test Self-Healing
description: Diagnose browser-test failures with preserved video and console/network evidence, verify test-only repairs, obtain review, and update canonical tests and knowledge.
setup_prompt: Use Browser Test Self-Healing with my existing browser QA foundation. Preserve original video and console/network evidence, classify the failure, propose only eligible test-automation repairs, and verify candidates in isolation with new evidence. End preparation with a durable pending review in the dashboard. Configure a separate later action route that validates the recorded approval, exact patch, and current source before applying, rerunning canonical tests, and updating knowledge and reporting.

setup_inputs.label: Browser foundation and application QA knowledge
Failure with original source and evidence
Canonical test source and expected base revision
Permitted test/config paths and related journeys
Original and verification video, console/network evidence policy

recommended_tools.name: Playwright CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Reproduce and verify the original and related browser journeys

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks managed agent-browser
recommended_tools.purpose: Investigate page state and collect supported video, console, network, error, screenshot, and trace evidence

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks browser recording
recommended_tools.purpose: Retain original, candidate, and canonical video plus redacted console/network evidence

recommended_tools.name: GitHub CLI or MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Optionally publish an authorized reviewed repair as a branch or pull request

recommended_tools.name: Issue-tracker MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Route product defects or environment blockers to the customer's chosen tracker

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
focus_areas: Failure diagnosis and proof that a repair preserves behavior
Repair confidence, evidence, and rollback readiness
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Locator contracts, repair boundaries, and canonical test ownership
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Acceptable automation boundaries and human oversight
Whether self-healing improves confidence without hiding defects
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Original and verification video, console/network logs, and other evidence references
Durable pending review plus approval and optional publication receipts
Updated application QA knowledge after healing
Live repair history and evidence dashboard
